testCase:
R-34: Browse a user homepage that reposted the top song from the Top 50 Rock chart.
Goal: Browse a user homepage that reposted the top song from the Top 50 Rock chart.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-34/
STEP 2: Hover over "Discover"
STEP 3: Click "Charts"
STEP 4: Choose "Rock" in "Genre" (with "Top 50" selected)
STEP 5: Click the first track, "Glass Harbour"
STEP 6: Click "Reposts"
STEP 7: Click "ember_riff"
STEP 8: Verify "who reposted" is visible

plan.title: Browse a top Rock track reposter

steps.note: Select Top 50 before choosing the genre.
Browse users who reposted the track.
Verify the requested text is visible.

reasoning: This tests navigation from the Top 50 Rock chart to the homepage of a user who reposted its top track. The plan follows the specified discovery flow and verifies the final page shows "who reposted".
